metadata.smoothing: none in panel (a); rolling window of 25 episodes in panel (b) only
metadata.caption: Per-episode training curves, mean ± 95% t-CI across 25 cells (5 seeds × 5 scenarios). Panel (a): raw episode return, no smoothing. Panel (b): goal-reach rate, per-cell rolling mean over a 25-episode window (full windows only), then averaged across cells. Vertical dashed lines mark training-iteration boundaries measured from the traces.

sample_efficiency.definition: Per cell, first 1-based episode at which the rolling (window=25, full windows only) goal-reach rate exceeds the threshold; 'never' = no crossing within the 500-episode budget. Across-cell median/IQR treat never as +inf and are null when fewer than the required share of cells crossed; reached_only_* restrict to crossing cells.

early_phase_advantage.definition: Per-cell mean episode return over episodes 1-50, paired across arms on common cells; two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank.

early_phase_mechanism.definition: Episodes 1-50. Traces record no episode length or termination reason; proxies used instead: goal_rate is exact (reached_goal field); minus5_fraction is exact for zero-valid-step invalid terminations (legacy mode: return == -5.0 only there); nongoal return magnitude is a cost-weighted length proxy (lambda_shape=0, each valid step adds a continuous positive cost). Invalid-after-k-steps, step-cap and dead-end terminations are NOT distinguishable.
early_phase_mechanism.verdict: CONFOUNDED (proxy-based): warm's early non-goal episodes accumulate significantly more step cost than cold's while its early goal-reach rate is not lower — consistent with cold's early-return edge coming from cheap terminations rather than better behavior. Report early-phase progress (goal-reach), not return. Confirm with explicit length/termination fields before publishing the mechanism claim.
